instruction: Take a picture of the current scene in the video and save it as 'scene.png' to the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires saving a screenshot to Desktop with specific filename. Evaluator checks if the Desktop directory contains the expected file by listing all PNG files and validates file properties (size, dimensions, format) to ensure it's a valid screenshot image.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage - evaluator verifies all instruction requirements: (1) file exists on Desktop, (2) filename is 'scene.png', (3) file is a valid PNG image with proper format
Getter logic is correct - uses glob to find PNG files in Desktop directory, uses PIL to validate image format, extracts size/dimensions/format properties
Metric logic is sound - validates existence, checks file size >= 1KB (not empty/corrupted), confirms valid PNG via PIL, verifies reasonable dimensions >= 100x100, confirms PNG format
Data flow is semantically correct - getter extracts the right state (Desktop PNG files with detailed properties), metric compares the right aspects (filename match + image validity)
Good edge case handling - handles missing files, empty/corrupted files (size check), non-PNG files (format check), tiny images (dimension check)
Expected value is semantically correct - 'scene.png' matches the instruction requirement exactly
Practically feasible - getter can access Desktop directory post-execution, PIL can validate PNG format, no state timing issues
